companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

steps.message: You can't get to The Rift from here.

lines.native: Buongiorno! A greeting and your name, please. Manners before market.
lines.translation: Good morning! A greeting and your name, please. Manners before market.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. The archway regards you with the patience of a queue that has become architecture.

lines.native: Ciao! Very good: greeting received. Now, your name, per favore? The visitors’ book cannot file you under ‘polite mystery.’
lines.translation: Hello! Very good: greeting received. Now, your name, please? The visitors’ book cannot file you under ‘polite mystery.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. She ticks one box with the satisfaction of a government achieving something small.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam! Your introduction is officially accepted. Now, non sono solo un arco. I am also someone you have not asked about. A small administrative omission.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam! Your introduction is officially accepted. Now, I am not just an archway. I am also someone you have not asked about. A small administrative omission.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. She enters Sam with a flourish, then leaves her own column conspicuously blank.

lines.native: Io mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! You asked about me. How unexpectedly considerate. Benvenuto al mercato! Your paperwork is immaculate. Please do not make this weird by mentioning the blush.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! You asked about me. How unexpectedly considerate. Welcome to the market! Your paperwork is immaculate. Please do not make this weird by mentioning the blush.
lines.narrative: The archway’s keystone blushes a faint terracotta. A visitors’ book snaps shut with the satisfaction of paperwork that has found love, or at least a complete form.
